messages:
eli: heads-up — PR #1288 stuck in CI: integration-e2e since the ecr cache-bump rolled yesterday. failing on infra setup step. need to land before Thursday freeze, any quick wins? :eyes:

ci-bot: failed job: integration-e2e (setup-infra)
logs: 
```
  Fetching docker image from ECR...
  Error: manifest not found for tag cache-bump-2026-03
  ```

santosh: ugh, that tag sounds like the new build policy. can we point the job at the fallback image?

maria: I can do a quick rebase and push a fix if that's the blocker. do we have a rebase window before the freeze? :clock1:

oncall: rebase windows are open tomorrow 09:00-10:30 PT for emergent landings. anything non-emergency should wait until post-freeze.

eli: this PR is a small schema change required by the billing side; product needs it in the Thursday deploy. i'd call it emergent.

maria: ok i'll take it. plan: rebase onto main, force-push a retry branch, open a rerun request. command i'll run: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease` then trigger `/ci rerun integration-e2e`

santosh: if retry still hits ECR manifest 404, try updating the job to use `image: fallback/infra:stable` temporarily — we did that for the last cache rotation. deployment team approved temporary fallback last week.

eli: deploy-bot, will fallback image be allowed during freeze window?

launch-deploy-bot: reminder: deploy freeze starts Thu 00:00 PT. Temporary infra fallbacks are permitted for emergency landings with oncall approval. Tag with `#emergency-landing` in the PR.

maria: rebase in progress, will ping when pushed. also adding `ci:rerun` label and note about fallback image if needed.

ci-bot: queued job: integration-e2e for branch pr/1288-rebase-1767777000

eli: thanks — if it still fails, santosh can try the fallback job edit. otherwise we'll use tomorrow morning rebase window. :thumbsup:

santosh: I'll be available 09:00 PT to help with any manual job tweaks.

maria: pushed and triggered rerun. link: https://ci.example.com/builds/5621 (will update)

ci-bot: build 5621 started.

ci-bot: build 5621 failed (setup-infra): same manifest 404.

maria: switching job to fallback image now and re-triggering. patch: https://git.example.com/redwood/infra-ci/-/merge_requests/342 (one-liner change in job image)

eli: leave note in PR: `#emergency-landing` and add oncall approval.

oncall: approved for emergency landing — fallback image ok for this landing. please tag me in the PR when green.

ci-bot: build 5627 started (with fallback image).

ci-bot: build 5627 succeeded.

maria: PR updated, green, oncall approved, labeled. requesting merge before freeze.

eli: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll queue the merge. please add a short postmortem bullet about the ECR tag rotation so we don't hit this again.

santosh: will add a note to the infra runbook and open a follow-up task to add a fallback in the job config automatically.

maria: merging now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: merged PR #1288 — landed by eli via merge-queue.

eli: closing thread — thanks all.
